guide_notes_p1: Select any text to apply Bold or Italic from the floating toolbar — you can mix both on the same word.
guide_notes_p2: Attach photos from your gallery or camera directly inside a note; images are stored locally and stay encrypted.
guide_notes_p3: Pin a note to keep it at the top of your list — tap the ⋮ menu or long-press the card to pin or unpin.
guide_checklist_p1: Tap the checkbox to mark an item done; tap the sort icon to switch between Pending-first, Completed-first, or A→Z ordering.
guide_checklist_p2: Swipe left on a row to delete it instantly. Compact view shows each item on a single line.
guide_checklist_p3: The note card shows total item count and how many are done — a quick progress glance without opening the note.
guide_itinerary_p1: Each destination entry holds a place name, arrival time, departure time, and a notes field for booking refs or directions.
guide_itinerary_p2: Tap the date or time chip on any entry to open the picker and reschedule — entries stay in chronological order automatically.
guide_itinerary_p3: The note card previews the total number of destinations so you can see your full trip scope at a glance.
guide_meal_plan_p1: Each day row has slots for Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner, and Snacks — leave any slot blank or remove if not needed. Add rows as needed
guide_meal_plan_p2: Tap a meal slot to type a dish name or add quick notes like prep reminders; changes save automatically.
guide_meal_plan_p3: The note card shows how many days are planned, giving an instant overview without opening the full note.
guide_recipe_p1: Set prep time, cook time, and servings at the top — servings appear on the note card for a quick reference.
guide_recipe_p2: Add ingredients with a name and quantity; drag the handle on any row to reorder without deleting and re-adding.
guide_recipe_p3: Steps are numbered automatically — insert a step anywhere in the list and the numbering updates itself.
guide_drawing_p1: Choose Pen, Highlighter, or Eraser from the bottom toolbar; adjust stroke colour and thickness before drawing.
guide_drawing_p2: Undo and redo every stroke individually with the ↩ / ↪ buttons — hold either button to step through history faster.
guide_drawing_p3: Tap Export Image in the toolbar to save your drawing to the device gallery as a full-resolution PNG.
guide_security_p1: All normal notes and drawings are encrypted with AES-256 using a key derived from your master password — unreadable without it.
guide_security_p2: After your first successful unlock, enable biometrics under Settings for quick fingerprint or Face ID access.
guide_security_p3: A green 🔒 icon on a note card means it was encrypted with current master password. An orange lock icon on a note card means it was encrypted with a different master password — enter the original password to read it.
guide_sync_p1: Sign in with Google under Settings → Account; tap Upload or Restore to push or pull — use the same account on every device.
guide_sync_p2: After reinstalling, sign in and tap Restore from Drive — the app fetches your encryption salt so all notes decrypt correctly.
guide_sync_p3: When the same note is edited on two devices, a conflict is flagged so you can choose Keep Local, Keep Remote, or Keep Both.
guide_controls_p1: Tap a note card to open it; long-press any card to enter multi-select mode — then tap more cards to add them to the selection.
guide_controls_p2: Swipe a card left to delete it. Inside a note, tap ⋮ to pin, change colour, change category, add an image, or delete the note.
guide_controls_p3: Tap the 👁 eye icon on any card to preview a note without opening the editor — useful for a quick read without leaving the list.
guide_organisation_p1: Tap the 🔍 search icon in the top bar to search across all note types — results match titles, body text, checklist items, destinations, meal entries, and recipe ingredients all at once.
guide_organisation_p2: Tap the sort icon to switch between Newest first, Oldest first, or Category view — in Category view each group (General, Work, Personal, Ideas) is collapsible.
guide_organisation_p3: Assign a category to any note inside the editor using the chip row below the title; assign a colour using ⋮ → Change Color to visually distinguish notes at a glance.
faq_lock_icon_q: Why is my note showing an orange lock icon with a different password message?
faq_lock_icon_a: The orange lock icon means the note was encrypted using a different master password than the one currently loaded. This usually happens after reinstalling the app and creating a new master password. Enter the original password used when the note was created to access it.
faq_forgot_password_q: What happens if I forget my master password?
faq_forgot_password_a: Notes are encrypted end-to-end with AES-256 and the password cannot be recovered by anyone — including the developer. If you have a Google Drive backup made while you still knew the password, restore it and enter the correct password. Without the original password, encrypted notes cannot be accessed. This is by design to protect your privacy.
faq_sync_devices_q: How do I sync notes across devices?
faq_sync_devices_a: Go to Settings → Account and sign in with the same Google account on each device. Tap Sync Now to upload or download. After reinstalling on a new device, sign in first and then tap Restore from Drive — the app fetches your encryption salt so your master password can decrypt everything correctly.
faq_notes_missing_q: Why are my notes not showing after reinstalling?
faq_notes_missing_a: Local notes are stored on-device and removed when you uninstall. If you had Drive sync enabled, sign back in under Settings → Account and tap Restore from Drive. If you exported a JSON backup via Settings → Storage → Download Notes JSON, tap Upload Notes JSON to import it back.
faq_no_account_q: Can I use Noteliha without an account?
faq_no_account_a: Yes — all six note types (Note, Checklist, Itinerary, Meal Plan, Recipe, Drawing) work fully offline with no account required. Notes are saved and encrypted on-device. An account is only needed if you want Google Drive sync or cross-device backup.
faq_export_backup_q: How do I export or back up my notes?
faq_export_backup_a: This feature is only available for Google Synced Users as of now. Go to Settings → Storage and tap Download Notes JSON to save an encrypted backup file to your device. To restore, tap Upload Notes JSON and select that file. Notes stay encrypted inside the file, so the backup is safe to store anywhere.
faq_canvas_preview_q: Why does the canvas look different in the list preview?
faq_canvas_preview_a: The note card shows a scaled-down thumbnail of your canvas for performance. The full-resolution drawing is always preserved — tap the note to open it at full size. The thumbnail refreshes every time you save.
faq_biometrics_a: After entering your master password correctly the first time, you can enrol biometrics under Settings. On subsequent launches the fingerprint or Face ID prompt appears automatically. If biometric auth fails or is cancelled, the app falls back to the master password screen.
faq_reorder_checklist_q: Can I reorder or sort checklist items?
faq_reorder_checklist_a: Yes. Inside a checklist note, tap the sort icon in the toolbar to switch between manual order, A→Z, Z→A, Pending-first, or Completed-first. You can also drag any item by its handle to place it exactly where you want — your chosen sort mode is remembered per note.
faq_delete_note_q: How do I permanently delete a note?
faq_delete_note_a: Swipe left on a note card to reveal the delete option, or long-press to enter multi-select mode and delete several notes at once. Deleted notes go to the Recycle Bin — open Settings → Recycle Bin to restore or permanently erase them.
faq_recover_note_q: I deleted a note by mistake — can I get it back?
faq_recover_note_a: Yes. Deleted notes are never removed immediately — they go to the Recycle Bin first. Open Settings → Recycle Bin, find your note, and tap Restore to bring it back. Notes only leave the bin permanently when you tap Empty Recycle Bin, so you have plenty of time to recover a mistake.
faq_share_note_q: How do I share a note?
faq_share_note_a: Long Press the note and tap Share icon to send it as plain text. Content is formatted per type — checklist items include their tick state, recipes list ingredients and steps, itineraries show each destination with dates and times. To share multiple notes at once, long-press a card to enter multi-select mode, select as many as you need, then tap the share icon in the top bar.
faq_change_colour_q: How do I change a note's colour?
faq_change_colour_a: Open the note and tap ⋮ → Change Color to pick from the available colour themes (such as Sunset, Lavender, Rose, and Forest). The chosen colour appears as the accent strip on the note card in the list, making it easy to visually distinguish notes at a glance. Colour is per-note and can be changed any time.
